description: buck2.nix (949 lines) mixes toolchain closure, rules.star render, buckconfig+test-cache wiring, sync.toml, enterShell bash and git hooks. Extract pure generators for rules.star/buckconfig/sync.toml with eval checks; one managed-symlink routine shared with direnv-lib; read toolchain.toml only through nix/lib/toolchain-declaration.nix.
title: Split buck2.nix into pure generators behind eval checks
